☀️ STAC WARS: Solar Radiation Analysis & Prediction Report

Problem Statement 2 Submission Report | Dataset: Voyage-123 Solar Observation Logs (32,686 records)

Part A & B: Data Visualization & Key Inferences

  • Diurnal Peak Timing: Solar radiation follows a bell-shaped diurnal distribution, peaking between 10:00 AM and 2:00 PM. The maximum average hourly radiation occurs at Hour 12 (12:00 PM - 1:00 PM) reaching 727.47 W/m².
  • Environmental Parameters: Temperature shows the strongest positive correlation with solar radiation (r = +0.7350). Humidity exhibits an inverse negative relationship (r = -0.2262).
  • Outlier Explanation: Standard atmospheric irradiance is ~1361 W/m². Sensor readings above 1000 W/m² (657 instances) are attributed to cloud-edge reflection / enhancement effects.

Bonus: Machine Learning Model (Solar Radiation Prediction)

  • Model Architecture: Random Forest Regressor (100 Decision Trees).
  • Target Leakage Avoidance: Sequential chronological train-test split (80% train / 20% test, shuffle=False) to prevent future data from leaking into past training data.
  • Evaluation Metrics: R² Score = 0.7301 | RMSE = 137.92 W/m²
  • Feature Importance: Temperature is the dominant feature (55.91%), followed by Hour of Day (27.36%).
